items.headline: Cloudflare outage causes widespread 500 errors, taking down major sites including X and ChatGPT; company cites spike in unusual traffic and later rules out cyberattack
Cloudflare says it has resolved network issues that caused outages at X, League of Legends and other apps; services now operating normally
Cloudflare outage causes service delays for websites like X and OpenAI, underscoring reliance on provider for global web traffic
Tech Field Day rundown highlights major Cloudflare global disruption that generated 500 errors and impacted ~20% of web traffic, including X and ChatGPT
Cloudflare status page reports and tracks major global network incident causing elevated errors, followed by implemented fix and monitoring
